The assigned driver marks the order ready for delivery: a 6-digit confirmation code is generated (stored hashed, valid 30 minutes) and sent to the buyer. The order must be SHIPPED. The order is NOT transitioned and escrow is NOT released here — the buyer must confirm the code via `POST /deliveries/:id/confirm`. Idempotent while a code is outstanding.

Wrong codes, expired codes and more than 5 attempts are rejected; the code is burned after the attempt limit is exceeded.
